description: Search DexSheet's dataset of crypto trading venues by free text (matches name, slug, summary and best_for) with optional filters for category, chain and US availability. Returns brief records with DexSheet page URL and open_url.

query.description: Free text, e.g. "copy trading", "solana terminal", "telegram". All words must match.

us_available.description: true = only venues whose geo.us is "available" or "partial"; false = only restricted ones.

name: search_venues
title: Search crypto trading venues
